description: Add a CLI contract test that checks every SKILL.md description length and angle-bracket rule and rejects symlinks in the claude-skills bundle, with negative fixtures
deviation_notes: All 9 top-level tasks are done and the 3 phase checkpoints are recorded, with a push after each phase. (1) The description parser accepts inline and |/> block forms and collapses whitespace. (2) The bundle check rejects symbolic links anywhere under claude-skills/, not only under measure/. (3) The negative fixtures build temporary trees so the rules are proven non-vacuous.
